summary: The note describes "The Rhythm of Calm," a poetry-based mindfulness and stress management workshop held in autumn 2023 at the Harmony Haven health retreat. Five coaches each led sessions on a theme: present-moment awareness, writing stillness, emotional resilience, daily practices, and meditation. The series closed with a sharing session and a final session on building a personal 'Mindfulness Continuum'.
one_line: A poetry-driven mindfulness workshop series at Harmony Haven in autumn 2023, led by five coaches, covering presence, resilience, daily practice, meditation and sustaining habits.
key_facts: "The Rhythm of Calm" is a mindfulness and stress management workshop that uses poetry, held in autumn 2023 at the Harmony Haven, a local health retreat.
Clara Devine, a mindfulness coach, led the opening session on October 3rd, guiding attendees to anchor in the present moment.
Clara Devine said, "The gift of mindfulness is the art of living poetically, where each moment is a line in the sonnet of your existence."
Elliot James, a stress management consultant, led the session on September 7th, likening the mind to a quill and having participants write short poems, haikus and single lines.
Sophia Laine, a psychologist, led the September 14th session on emotional resilience, integrating mindfulness with emotive expression; participants wrote stanzas about their feelings.
Marco Rivera, a life coach, led the September 21st session on turning mundane activities like brushing teeth or sipping tea into acts of mindfulness.
Lila Torres, a meditation instructor, led the September 28th session on meditation as a tool for deepening mindfulness, emphasizing silence between verses.
The October 5th session was a sharing session in which participants read personal poems and stories; Clara Devine returned to conclude it.

On October 12th, the workshop focused on sustaining practice; with all five coaches present, each participant crafted a personalized 'Mindfulness Continuum' of practices, routines and poetic reflections.
The note's dates are out of chronological order: the opening session is dated October 3rd, yet later sessions are dated September 7th through 28th, followed by October 5th and 12th.
The coaches stated in unison that dedication to mindfulness "is not confined to moments of stillness."
